postconditions.description: The first output line is either 'YES' or 'NO'.
If 'YES' is output, there are exactly 4 - n more output lines with integers.
If 'NO' is output, there is exactly one output line.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= 10^6 for b in output_lines[1:])
postconditions.description: All integers in the additional output lines are between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output_line_1 == 'YES' implies (lambda x: x[0] == x[1] == x[2] == x[3])(sorted(input_lines[1:] + output_lines[1:]))
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is output, the sorted list of all numbers (including the missing ones) has the same mean, median, and range.

postconditions.expression: output_line_1 == 'NO' implies not any(lambda x: x[0] == x[1] == x[2] == x[3])([sorted(input_lines[1:] + [b]) for b in range(1, 10^6 + 1)])
postconditions.description: If 'NO' is output, no combination of the given numbers and a range of possible missing numbers has the same mean, median, and range.
